title: Unlabeled reel

lines.text: Engineering memo, Arthur Penrose. October sixteenth. Overdrive run five, complete.
The ghost was on the monitor again. Thursday's programs, plain as day.
I've stopped telling Walter what I see. He only asks whether Futura will be pleased.
The log stays in my locker. Same combination as the demonstration date - month, then day.
God help me, I want to see what happens next. End of memo.

evidenceNote: Rosa found it in the erase bin. Penrose's voice, but played forwards it is gibberish - as if the reel had been threaded backwards when it was recorded.
